scope: MJ-REQ-173 upload-security acceptance across all seven supported uploaded document kinds
acceptance: All seven uploaded document kinds reject path traversal, disallowed executable extensions, executable-signature data presented as PDF, MIME/extension mismatch, invalid DOCX content, empty content, overlong names, and non-NFC names without creating upload storage or metadata.
All seven document kinds reject an actual body larger than 10 MiB. A request with an underreported Content-Length is also rejected by the streamed body limit.

Two distinct documents with the same visible filename retain distinct content-addressed identities and bytes; metadata and bytes survive a fresh Store/API reopen, while a second profile sees no documents.
Connected Chromium acceptance uploads each of the seven supported kinds, reloads the browser, and reads back the selected collection versions.

environment.database: Synthetic SQLite databases in temporary directories
environment.browser: Local headless Chromium through Playwright; loopback fixture only

checks.details: Includes API validation for all seven upload kinds, true streamed size limits, collision safety, Store reopen/profile isolation, SQLite migration preservation, and connected Chromium upload/reload/download workflows.
npm emitted EBADENGINE because Vitest declares Node ^22.12, ^24, or >=26 while this machine has Node 25.9.0.

resolved_test_setup_failures: An initial combined integration/browser run could not find the Applications navigation control because the isolated worktree had no frontend node_modules or dist bundle. After npm ci/build, the isolated browser test passed and the final combined matrix passed 16/16 with no skips.

Early test-authoring runs exposed fixture setup errors (raw non-ASCII HTTP header, absent uploads directory on rejected requests, and a missing second profile); the tests were corrected to follow the encoded browser header contract and create only the profiles they assert. No production-code failure was observed.

security_boundary.data: Synthetic resume/document bytes, filenames, and profile-owned metadata only
security_boundary.external_requests: No providers, employers, or real application destinations contacted

limitations: No PostgreSQL or Docker run; this slice makes no schema or database-backend changes. SQLite upgrade/downgrade preservation ran in the focused integration suite.
Hosted CI and independent reviews remain NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY; local PASS does not promote hosted/release evidence.
